territory: Volatility-ETP term structure and roll: VXX/VIXY/UVXY/SVXY/VIXM/VXZ against the CBOE VIX term-structure indices. Short-vol carry, roll-yield timing, vol-ETP decay, long/short vol-ETP pairs.
verdict: NOISE. No formula clears the multiple-testing bar, and the single one that clears the expected-max fails the lag-kill test and collapses out of sample.
why_this_is_a_different_failure_from_the: This is NOT a staleness artefact and NOT a broken mechanism. The mechanism is real and measured here: the 30d->93d VIX curve slopes up on 93.4% of design days and 92.8% of holdout days, so the mandated daily front->second roll genuinely is a cost to the long-vol holder. Territory-wide the mean design Sharpe falls only from 0.62 at lag0 to 0.54 at lag1, i.e. essentially nothing here lives on quote staleness -- these are slow signals reading slow indices. The edge is absent for the opposite reason: the roll is already fully expressed in a beta anyone can buy in one ticker, that beta's risk-adjusted return is poor (Sharpe 0.64 design, 0.44 holdout, -93% max drawdown, -83% worst day), and no free-data curve-timing signal improved on gating it at random.

data.source: Yahoo chart API v8, keyless and free; cached raw at research/data/volterm_cache/raw/
data.why_the_panel_starts_2011_10_04: SVXY and UVXY both list that day; nothing is back-filled and no dead ETP (XIV, TVIX) is spliced in.
data.vix_futures_curve_note: CBOE VX futures settlements are not on any free keyless endpoint reachable from this host, so the curve is proxied two ways: (a) the CBOE VIX term-structure INDICES (^VIX9D/^VIX/^VIX3M/^VIX6M), and (b) tradable ETP maturity ladders (VIXM vs VIXY), which measure the realised roll in prices anyone can actually trade. (b) is the stronger of the two and is what groups B and E run on.

survivorship_and_tail_honesty.splice_guard: |r| > 3.0 only. The 0.75 guard used by this programme's equity ladders would have deleted exactly the days this territory is about.
survivorship_and_tail_honesty.the_tail_cannot_be_dodged_at_daily_close: SVXY's NAV collapse happened between 16:00 and 16:15 ET on 2018-02-05. A VIX-level gate reading the 2018-02-05 close (VIX 37.32) exits at the 2018-02-06 close, i.e. after eating the full -83%. Every gated formula here shows worst_day = -83% or a value it only avoided by being flat for unrelated reasons. No daily-close rule in this sweep bounds the 2018 tail, and none is claimed to.
survivorship_and_tail_honesty.leverage_regime_changes_inside_the_desig: SVXY -1x -> -0.5x and UVXY 2x -> 1.5x on 2018-02-28; both are left in as they happened.

G0_mechanism.implemented: Every formula carries a one-sentence causal 'why' and an A-PRIORI SIGN. The sweep is NOT sign-agnostic and scores every formula AS WRITTEN; a good Sharpe on the flipped sign counts as a failure.
G0_mechanism.forced_trader: Constant-maturity VIX ETPs must roll a fixed fraction of their book from the front to the second contract every single day, on a published schedule, without regard to price. Levered and inverse ETPs must additionally rebalance to target leverage at every close.
G0_mechanism.friction: The variance risk premium keeps that curve in contango ~93% of days, so the forced roll is a persistent, calendar-driven transfer from the long-vol holder to the short-vol holder.
G0_mechanism.mechanism_verdict: REAL and confirmed in the data. It is also fully priced: it is available as a one-ticker beta, and that beta is a bad risk-adjusted trade.

G1_lagkill.convention: _legs(S, W, lag). lag=0: signal at close t, MOC fill same close, earns t->t+1 (reference only, this is a 15-minute lookahead on ^VIX's 16:15 print). lag=1: fill MOC at close t+1, earns t+1->t+2 -- THE HEADLINE. lag=2: the kill test.
G1_lagkill.reading: An 0.08 Sharpe drop across 41 formulas. This territory is not staleness-driven; the lag-kill gate has almost nothing to bite on.
G1_lagkill.the_one_formula_it_did_kill: D2_VIX_MA_GATE, the design leader: Sharpe 1.08 at lag1 -> 0.68 at lag2, retention 0.63. It then went to 0.17 out of sample.
G1_lagkill.vacuous_for_static_positions: Z0, Z1, B4, B8 and D6 hold fixed weights, so they have no signal for an extra lag to delay. Their retention of 1.00 is arithmetic, not evidence.

G2_statistics.unevaluable_reason: Backwardation is rare enough that these were live on fewer than 200 design days; they are counted as tried but cannot be scored.
G2_statistics.bootstrap_construction: max over formulas of AS-WRITTEN net-of-cost Sharpe (signs fixed a priori); circular shift of the realised return matrix against fixed weights, B=3000, preserving turnover, cost lines, return autocorrelation, cross-asset correlation and the correlation BETWEEN formulas.
G2_statistics.why_this_null_is_the_right_one_here: A circular shift does NOT destroy SVXY's positive drift, and that is deliberate. Almost every formula in this sweep is 'hold SVXY, sometimes'. The bootstrap therefore answers exactly the question that matters: what Sharpe does the BEST of 39 arbitrarily-timed gates on SVXY reach by luck alone? Answer: 1.00. To claim the VIX curve carries information, a formula has to beat that, and none does.

harness_selftest.reading: The harness finds a planted lag-1-tradable edge at Sharpe 3.96, reports -5.47 rather than +5.47 when the sign is wrong, sits inside the noise band on a random walk, and annihilates a perfectly stale signal (20.81 -> 0.01). 'Noise' is therefore a finding, not a broken harness.

Z0_STATIC_LONG_SVXY.name: Z0_STATIC_LONG_SVXY
Z0_STATIC_LONG_SVXY.why: BENCHMARK, not a formula: hold the inverse short-term VIX-futures ETP always. Every gated formula below is a subset of this position, so this is the bar.

Z1_STATIC_SHORT_VIXY.name: Z1_STATIC_SHORT_VIXY
Z1_STATIC_SHORT_VIXY.why: BENCHMARK: the same short-vol exposure expressed by borrowing the long-vol ETP, so the 5%/yr borrow line is visible next to the borrow-free SVXY version.

top_formulas.name: D2_VIX_MA_GATE
top_formulas.why: Long SVXY only while VIX is below its own 50d average: vol is a regime variable and the roll is only reliably paid inside the calm regime.

top_formulas.name: B2_ETP_LADDER_CARRY_21
top_formulas.why: Same tradable roll estimator over 21 days: a faster read of whether the front bucket is currently the one being bled by the roll.

top_formulas.name: B6_REALISED_DECAY
top_formulas.why: Long SVXY when the front ETP has been decaying over the last 21 days: the ETP's own realised drift is the most direct evidence that the forced roll is currently a cost.

top_formulas.name: G3_MID_BUCKET_CARRY
top_formulas.why: Long VIXM-short-side via a short VIXM position in contango: the mid bucket also pays a roll, smaller but far less convex, so it is the low-tail version of the same trade.

top_formulas.name: G1_VVIX_SCALED_CARRY
top_formulas.why: Long SVXY in contango, sized inversely to z252 of VVIX: the price of VIX convexity is the market's own quote for the risk this book is short.

top_formulas.name: A1_CONTANGO_SIGN_3M
top_formulas.why: Long SVXY only while log(VIX3M/VIX)>0: the forced daily front->second roll is a loss for the long-vol holder exactly when the 30d->93d curve slopes up.

top_formulas.name: A4_NEARSLOPE_SIGN
top_formulas.why: Long SVXY only while log(VIX/VIX9D)>0: the 9d->30d segment inverts FIRST in a vol shock, so it is the earliest free read that the forced roll has flipped.

top_formulas.name: D4_INVERSION_KILL
top_formulas.why: Long SVXY unless the 9d->30d segment has inverted: the near segment inverts first, so it is the cheapest available kill switch on the forced roll flipping sign.

top_formulas.name: A7_SLOPE_MOMENTUM
top_formulas.why: Long SVXY when the 30d->93d slope has STEEPENED over 5 days: the forced roll cost the long-vol ETP pays is re-set daily, so a steepening curve raises tomorrow's carry.

top_formulas.name: D8_EQUITY_HEDGED_CARRY
top_formulas.why: Long SVXY, short 0.35 SPY: strip the equity beta so what is left is the roll and the variance premium rather than a leveraged bet that stocks go up.

top_formulas.name: C5_VRP_AND_CONTANGO
top_formulas.why: Long SVXY only when the premium exists AND the curve slopes up: the premium is the cause, the slope is the transmission; require both links of the chain.

top_formulas.name: B4_CAL_SPREAD_STATIC
top_formulas.why: Always long VIXM / short VIXY, gross 1: a pure maturity spread on one curve. The front bucket rolls a bigger fraction of its book per day than the mid bucket, so the spread harvests the roll differential with no outright vol direction.

holdout_note: DIAGNOSTIC ONLY. No formula passed the design gate, so no holdout number is being used to promote anything and none was peeked at before the design verdict was fixed. It is recorded because a negative territory is more useful with its out-of-sample behaviour attached.

the_one_object_worth_naming_and_why_it_s.name: B4_CAL_SPREAD_STATIC
the_one_object_worth_naming_and_why_it_s.what: Static long VIXM / short VIXY, gross 1. A pure maturity spread on one curve: the front bucket rolls a larger fraction of its book per day than the mid bucket, so the spread harvests the roll differential with no outright vol direction.
why_it_fails_anyway: Design bootstrap p = 1.000. Every one of 3000 null draws produced a best-of-39 Sharpe at or above its 0.70, so it does not clear the bar it has to clear.
It is a STATIC position, so the lag-kill gate is vacuous for it. It passes G1 by having no signal to delay, which is not the same as passing it.
Even at a physically impossible 0% VIXY borrow it only reaches design Sharpe 0.83, still under the 1.00 expected-max.
Its held-out t of 1.52 over 6.6 years is not significant on its own and is nowhere near the 2.8 this programme's basket gate requires.
The 5%/yr VIXY borrow used here is an ASSUMPTION, not a measurement. VIXY is a crowded short and this programme has been burned before by treating an unmeasured cost as zero.

what_would_change_the_answer: Actual CBOE VX futures settlement history (VX1..VX8), which would give the real front-back basis in points per day instead of an index proxy, and would let the roll be measured per contract rather than inferred. It is free but not on a keyless endpoint reachable headlessly from this host.

Intraday data. Every result here is close-to-close, which is exactly the granularity at which the 2018 tail is unhedgeable. The forced roll is executed in a known window near the close, and whatever is left in this territory is probably in that window, not in daily bars.
A measured VIXY/VXX borrow curve rather than the assumed 5%/yr.
